findingDetails.title: RRF-fused scores are normalised, thresholded and bonus-adjusted as if they were weighted sums
findingDetails.affectedSurfaceHints: fusion.ts:1189 score source -> fusion.ts:1208 confidence normalisation -> fusion.ts:1260-1265 comparator bonuses -> handlers/advisor-recommend.ts:586 ambiguous/effective thresholds
findingDetails.case: With SPECKIT_ADVISOR_RRF_FUSION=1, a candidate matching all four live lanes at rank 1 scores at most 0.95/(8+1) = 0.106, so liveNormalized is about 0.11 and confidence about 0.58 instead of the 0.83 the same match gets on the weighted path; and a routing constant of 0.5 exceeds the whole RRF range.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Read the surrounding call sites and the calibration constants; a following probe of the weighted path matched the documented behaviour, which is why no P0/P1 is claimed.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: Intentional calibration of the RRF path or of the slash heuristic; no comment or test states that, so it stays a defect report rather than a confirmed mis-tuning.

findingDetails.title: Low-information abstention counts stop words, drifting from the policy's own meaningful-token measure
findingDetails.affectedSurfaceHints: prompt-policy.ts:130-141 exported promptPolicyTokens contract -> fusion.ts:1304-1306 whitespace split -> fusion.ts:1333 lowInfoAmbiguityFloor abstention

findingDetails.title: heldBelow names a single holder, so the ambiguity exception misses a cap set by another holder
findingDetails.affectedSurfaceHints: fusion.ts:545-558 binding holder selection -> ambiguity.ts:68 heldBelow exception -> ambiguity.ts:70 score margin
findingDetails.case: Two slash-anchored seeds such as /deep:review and /deep:research both hold one target; heldBelow records only the lower seed, so if the higher seed is the passing top the target's 1e-6 gap still falls inside AMBIGUITY_MARGIN and the pair reports as a coin flip.
